acceptanceCriteria.text: A chat PTY with a shell running under its CLI is not stopped at 10 quiet minutes; it is stopped 10 minutes after the shell was last seen (terminalSessions.lifecycle.test.ts, 'idle stop with a shell running')
cmd.exe under the CLI (npx MCP servers, .cmd shims) never keeps a PTY alive (runningShell.test.ts; runningShell.real.test.ts on Windows)
A process listing that fails is reported and the PTY is stopped as before (terminalSessions.edges.test.ts)
lint, typecheck, deadcode, build and the full test suite pass (except the Windows-only symlink EPERM tests, which fail only locally)

body:
## Problem
Agent chats in the app were stopped after 10 minutes with no terminal input or output (`Stopped after 10 minutes idle.`). A long command an agent runs (a test run, a build, a job left running in the background) can print nothing for longer than that, so long jobs were killed part way.

## Change (already implemented in the working tree, not committed)
- `src/main/terminals/runningShell.ts` (new): lists processes with their parents (`ps`; `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process` in Windows PowerShell on Windows) and answers whether a shell (bash, sh, zsh, fish, PowerShell, pwsh, …) runs under the PTY's CLI. `cmd.exe` never counts, because `npx` MCP servers run in it for the whole session (checked on this machine: `rea` runs as `cmd.exe /d /c npx …`). A shell the CLI was launched through doesn't count either (a `.cmd` shim, or a CLI that is itself a shell script).
- `terminalSessions.ts` `watchLive`: when the idle timer finds the PTY quiet for 10 minutes, it lists processes before stopping. A shell found running counts as activity at that moment, so the PTY is checked again 10 minutes later. A listing that fails is reported through `onError`, and the PTY stops as before.
- Docs: `docs/design/chat-shells.md` (Idle stop), `docs/architecture.md`.

## Tests
- `runningShell.test.ts`: tree rules (CLI → bash counts; cmd.exe MCP wrapper, `.cmd` shim and shell-script launch don't count; looping parents), parsing, and the PowerShell/ps invocations.
- `runningShell.real.test.ts`: real process trees on the current platform (a shell under the program → true; a node child → false; on Windows, cmd.exe → false).
- `terminalSessions.lifecycle.test.ts` / `terminalSessions.edges.test.ts`: kept alive while a shell runs, then stopped 10 minutes after it was last seen. Also: a failing listing is reported and the PTY stops; output that arrives during a listing keeps the PTY; a PTY that exits during a listing gets nothing more.
title: Keep a chat terminal running while a shell runs under its CLI
